title: Subiendo en el Metrocable a Parque Arví

dialogue.speaker: Daniela
dialogue.spanish: ¡Uy, Mateo, mirá esa vista de todo el valle desde la cabina del Metrocable! Qué belleza, ¿cierto?
dialogue.english: Whoa, Mateo, look at that view of the whole valley from the Metrocable gondola! What a beauty, right?

dialogue.speaker: Mateo
dialogue.spanish: ¡Sí, está bacanísimo! Pues menos mal que madrugamos hoy porque la fila en la estación Acevedo ya estaba larga.
dialogue.english: Yes, it's super cool! Well thank goodness we got up early today because the line at Acevedo station was already long.

slang.example: El paseo por el eje cafetero estuvo bacanísimo.

dialogue.speaker: Daniela
dialogue.spanish: Bueno, acuérdate que en la estación Santo Domingo tenemos que hacer transbordo a la línea del parque.
dialogue.english: Well, remember that at Santo Domingo station we have to transfer to the park line.

dialogue.speaker: Mateo
dialogue.spanish: O sea, ¿allá arriba en el bosque hace mucho más frío que acá en Medellín?
dialogue.english: I mean, is it much colder up there in the forest than down here in Medellín?

dialogue.speaker: Daniela
dialogue.spanish: Claro, baja como ocho grados. Por eso traje dos chompas en el morral para no pasar frío.
dialogue.english: Of course, it drops about eight degrees. That's why I brought two jackets in my backpack so we don't get cold.

slang.actualMeaning: jackets / hoodies / warm sweaters (Colombian & Andean Spanish)
slang.example: Llevá la chompa porque por la noche refresca bastante.

dialogue.speaker: Mateo
dialogue.spanish: ¡Qué jugada maestra! Apenas lleguemos arriba compramos fresas con crema en el mercado campesino.
dialogue.english: What a pro move! As soon as we get to the top let's buy strawberries and cream at the farmers' market.

questions.question: How are Daniela and Mateo traveling up to Parque Arví?
options: By aerial gondola on the Medellín Metrocable, transferring at Santo Domingo station
By rental car along the highway
By tour bus from downtown Bogotá
questions.explanation: They are riding 'la cabina del Metrocable' and transferring at 'la estación Santo Domingo.'

questions.question: Why did Daniela pack two jackets ('dos chompas') in her backpack?
options: The temperature up in the forest drops about 8 degrees cooler than in the city
She wants to sell them at the market
The air conditioning inside the gondola is too strong
They are camping overnight in the woods
questions.explanation: Daniela explains: 'baja como ocho grados. Por eso traje dos chompas en el morral para no pasar frío.'

questions.question: What snack does Mateo want to buy when they arrive at the farmers' market at the top?
questions.explanation: Mateo says: 'Apenas lleguemos arriba compramos fresas con crema en el mercado campesino.'

questions.question: Slang Side Quest: In Colombia, what do 'bacanísimo', 'chompas', and 'morral' mean?
questions.explanation: In Colombia, 'bacano / bacanísimo' means cool/awesome, 'una chompa' is a jacket/hoodie, and 'el morral' is a backpack!
